description: This file defines the SettingsFragment class, which is a UI component within an Android application that displays a settings screen with a simple heading. It contains method overrides for creating the view and a factory method for instantiation.

classes.name: SettingsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that inflates a settings layout and provides a factory method for creating new instances.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides the Fragment method to create and return the view hierarchy associated with the fragment.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of SettingsFragment.
